mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park, though please note an elevated air quality alert with an index of 56.

City officials are busy with preparations for the upcoming tax season, reminding residents that tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th, while the Plan Commission prepares for a November 4th meeting to review new residential and site plan developments.

There is plenty to do around town, starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 events, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing at 6:30 PM. Looking ahead, you can catch live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report from last Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, and since the restaurant is open and serving until 10:00 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
